content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint lacks explicit analysis for ORR",
      "quote": "Confirmed ORR according to RECIST v1.1, as assessed by ICR.",
      "page": 37,
      "section": "3 Objectives and Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The primary endpoint is listed but the statistical analysis section (Table 17) does not explicitly state the analysis for the primary endpoint, only for secondary endpoints. The analysis for ORR is mentioned in Table 17 but not clearly linked to the primary objective.",
      "fix": "Explicitly state the primary analysis for the primary endpoint (ORR by ICR) in the statistical analysis section, including the estimand and analysis method."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing estimand attributes for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "Confirmed ORR according to RECIST v1.1, as assessed by ICR.",
      "page": 37,
      "section": "3 Objectives and Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The estimand for the primary endpoint is not fully specified: population (FAS is implied but not stated for the primary estimand), intercurrent events (e.g., treatment discontinuation, death) are not defined, and the summary measure is not explicitly stated as a proportion with CI.",
      "fix": "Define the estimand for the primary endpoint including population, variable, intercurrent event handling, and summary measure."
    },
    {
      "title": "No analysis specified for PK endpoint",
      "quote": "Serum concentration of T-DXd, total anti-HER2 antibody and MAAA-1181a.",
      "page": 37,
      "section": "3 Objectives and Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The PK endpoint is listed but no statistical analysis is described in Section 9.4 for PK parameters (e.g., Cmax, AUC). The analysis populations table mentions PK Analysis Set but no analysis methods are provided.",
      "fix": "Add a description of PK analysis methods, including parameters to be estimated and how they will be summarized."
    },
    {
      "title": "No analysis specified for immunogenicity endpoint",
      "quote": "Presence of ADAs for T-DXd.",
      "page": 37,
      "section": "3 Objectives and Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The immunogenicity endpoint is listed but no statistical analysis is described for ADA data in Section 9.4.",
      "fix": "Add a description of ADA analysis, including incidence rates and any statistical methods."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing handling of missing data",
      "quote": "procedures for accounting for missing, unused, and spurious data.",
      "page": 92,
      "section": "9.4 Statistical Analyses",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The text says a SAP will describe procedures for missing data, but the protocol itself does not specify the primary approach for handling missing data for key endpoints (e.g., ORR, PFS, OS). This is a gap in the protocol.",
      "fix": "Specify the primary missing data handling strategy for each endpoint in the protocol, or at least for the primary endpoint."
    },
    {
      "title": "No multiplicity control for secondary endpoints",
      "quote": "To further evaluate the efficacy of T-DXd in patients with metastatic or unresectable tumors harboring pre-specified HER2 activating mutations across tumor types.",
      "page": 37,
      "section": "3 Objectives and Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Multiple secondary endpoints (DoR, DCR, PFS, OS, etc.) are listed, but no adjustment for multiplicity is described in the statistical section. This could lead to inflated type I error.",
      "fix": "Describe the multiplicity control strategy for secondary endpoints, or state that no adjustment is made and justify."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size justification lacks effect size and power",
      "quote": "A sample size of 100 patients has been determined to provide sufficient precision for the estimation of the ORR in this population",
      "page": 90,
      "section": "9.2 Sample Size Determination",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The sample size is based on precision of ORR, but no target effect size, null hypothesis, or power is stated. For a single-arm study, it is common to specify a null ORR and a target ORR, but these are missing.",
      "fix": "Specify the null and alternative ORR values, and the desired power or precision, to justify the sample size."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistency in sample size statement",
      "quote": "A sample size of 100 patients has been determined to provide sufficient precision for the estimation of the ORR in this population",
      "page": 90,
      "section": "9.2 Sample Size Determination",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The text says 'A sample size of 100 patients' but later says 'Approximately 100 patients will be treated' and 'maximum of approximately 20 patients per tumor type'. This is not necessarily inconsistent, but the 'approximately' could be clarified.",
      "fix": "Clarify whether the sample size is fixed at 100 or may vary, and how the per-tumor cap affects the total."
    }
  ]
}
